events.title: Applied Digital funds a $97M convertible loan to ChronoScale
events.detail: Applied Digital reported funding the full $97 million unsecured, non-interest-bearing note to ChronoScale. Conversion into 12,125,000 ChronoScale common shares at $8 requires the specified approval to take effect. Otherwise the principal matures December 31, 2026. Applied Digital is the lender. The reported transaction does not revise its historical consolidated debt or cash balance.
supporting_passages: providing for an unsecured loan in the aggregate principal amount of $97.0 million (the "Principal Amount"), the entire amount of which has been funded.

Upon the effectiveness of the Stockholder Approval (as defined below), the outstanding Principal Amount will automatically convert into 12,125,000 shares of Common Stock, equal to the Principal Amount divided by $8.00 per share, subject to adjustment for stock splits, combinations and reclassifications.
No interest accrues or is payable on the Principal Amount, including during the existence of any event of default.
If not otherwise converted pursuant to its terms as described above into shares of Common Stock, the outstanding Principal Amount will mature on December 31, 2026 (the "Maturity Date").

events.title: ChronoScale signs agreements for a phased Odessa deployment
events.detail: ChronoScale, which Applied Digital controls, announced agreements for a 50/50 development partnership with STN. The customer ordered a 65 MW first phase targeted for the first half of 2027. ChronoScale estimates up to $7.5 billion of partnership contract value over six years, subject to performance and delivery. Later phases are potential orders. No operating capacity, customer acceptance or Applied Digital revenue is recorded from this announcement.
supporting_passages: entered into definitive agreements to form a 50/50 development partnership with STN, Inc. to develop its Odessa, Texas site
